title: Metoyer's slow start: sixteen lessons before touching the horn
summary: Metoyer first taught reading, then had his daughter play major and minor chords for Ernie to identify, and made him learn the parts of the horn. Ernie could not play with others for a year or two.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: How long did you stay with him?

Well I stayed with Alma Twi for about two years. You started right at the beginning? And then he died. Have you been blowing on the horn at all? No, right from the beginning. But it was about, I took about sixteen lessons before he'd ever let me touch the horn. Just reading music? Just reading music and then after I did that then he would let his daughter go in the rum and make chords on the piano and make me distinguish between the minors and the majors. Oh yeah. And then he, when he did get the horn, he took it all apart and made me name the parts of the horn and told me how to assemble it together. Then he started me to play.
Did you have any book for that self edge or whatever they call it? For that book? The reading and all that. Did he make you sing those things?
Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. Oh yeah. I had to hum the minor chords and the major chords as she would call me and distinctly tell him which was which.
Did you have any book for that or did he write it out?

No, he didn't have no book. It actually was a year training from the other room. What she was doing I'm supposed to detect me, tell him whether it was a minor or a major. He would have me guessing whether she was playing in sharps or flats. You see, about a year training from that time. But I hadn't even touched the horn as yet. And he started me on the horn and after I got up away, he told me that, Don't go play with nobody. Better than a year, two years before he would let me play with anybody. And then when I did go out, I started playing with small groups, different fellas.
